pages.text: While most ores you'll need are added by other mods. RedstoneStick's Iron Man Mod adds a few crucial ores of its own to the overworld to be used in crafting the mods items.

The next pages will explain what ores are added, how they spawn, how to harvest them and will give a brief explanation on their uses.$(br2)Additionally some ores spawn as a part of large veins that include more than just that ore. So they can be a good source of other materials than its primary content.

$(2)Palladium$() is a common overworld ore that can be found between Y=-100 and Y=-20 with a density of 2 veins per chunk, in a triangular distribution. Meaning you'll find more of them around Y=-60$(br2)Additional 2 veins per chunk can be found buried in the same altitudes.
pages.title: Palladium

pages.text: $(2)Magnesium$() actually makes up a large portion of the overworlds soil. But its not enough to be useful to us.$(br2)We can however find enough magnesium concentration in certain gravel patches located in $(2)Cold Ocean$() biomes, once every 4 chunks.
pages.title: Magnesium

pages.text: $(2)Magnesium Rich Gravel$() is not so similar to the ores you're used to seeing, its more akin to $(2)Suspicious Gravel$() than a actual ore.$(br2)Thus you require a $(2)Brush$() to extract the magnesium from it.$(br2)Good news is its much sturdier than Suspicious Gravel, meaning you can pick it up and transport it using a shovel.
pages.title: Magnesium Harvesting

pages.text: Naturally occurring Magnesium Rich Gravel and the brushing process. (With added lights).

$(2)Platinum$() is one of the rarest ores you can find in overworld.$(br2)Its not possible to find it by itself. Instead small amounts can be found in $(2)Placer Deposits$() mixed with other rare ores.$(br2)Next few pages will explain $(2)Placer Deposits$() in detail.
pages.title: Platinum

pages.text: $(2)Placer Deposits$() form in $(2)River$() biomes as sediment collecting on the floor. The are quite rare and can be found only once every 32 chunks.$(br2)They can be distinguished by the gold ore that can be found on its top layer.
pages.title: Placer Deposits

pages.text: $(2)Placer Deposits$() form as layers;$(br2)- High layers contain only $(2)Black Sand$() and trace amounts $(2)Gold$().$(br)- Middle layers contain higher amounts of $(2)Gold$() and small amounts of $(2)Platinum$().$(br)- Lower layers are mostly composed of $(2)Gold$(), $(2)Platinum$() and trace amounts of $(2)Diamond$().
pages.title: Deposit Formation

pages.text: Placer Deposit cut out to show its layer formation.
Simply breaking any $(2)Black Sand$() ore variant without silk touch will cause it to drop its ore.$(br2)These drops are affected by $(2)Fortune$().
pages.title: Black Sand Harvesting
Smelting
pages.text: You can also smelt the $(2)Black Sand$() block itself to get iron ingots.$(br2)All in all $(2)Placer Deposits$() are a source of lots of valuable materials. And the only source of $(2)Platinum$() available.

While 'RedstoneStick's Iron Man Mod' adds its own ores. It heavily relies on its parent mod 'Radiated' for the base ores.$(br2)The information about all the ores that might be necessary and more, can be found on Radiated's own guide book.
